# 中国辉山乳业（6863 HK）：几近归零

<!--en-->
*China Huishan Dairy (6863 HK): A Near Zero*

<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>公司：\n中国辉山乳业控股有限公司</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>股价：2.85港元</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>股票代码：\n6863 HK</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>市值：384亿港元</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>行业：\n乳制品</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>流通股数：35亿股</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>报告日期：\n2016年12月16日</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>平均成交量（30天）：1190万股</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Company:\nChina Huishan Dairy Holdings Co Ltd.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Stock Price: HKD 2.85</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Ticker:\n6863 HK</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Market Cap: HKD 38.4 billion</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Industry:\nDairy</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Float: 3.5 billion shares</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Report Date:\nDecember 16, 2016</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Average Volume (30-day): 11.9 million shares</td></tr></table>

<div style="text-align: center;"><div style="text-align: center;">Part 1</div> </div>

我们做空中国辉山乳业控股有限公司（6863 HK / “辉山”），因为我们认为其价值接近于零。我们判定辉山是一家欺诈性公司。在这份关于辉山的首次报告中，我们将详细说明以下结论及支撑事实。

<!--en-->
We are short China Huishan Dairy Holdings (6863 HK / “Huishan”) because we believe it is worth close to Zero. We conclude Huishan is a fraud. In this first report on Huishan, we detail the following conclusions and supporting facts.

至少自2014年起，该公司便通过谎称自身在苜蓿生产方面基本自给自足来虚报利润。我们发现大量证据表明，辉山长期从第三方采购大量苜蓿；这使我们确信辉山的财务报表存在造假行为。

<!--en-->
Since at least 2014, the company has reported fraudulent profits largely based on the lie that it is substantially self-sufficient in producing alfalfa. We found overwhelming evidence that Huishan has long purchased substantial quantities of alfalfa from third parties, which gives us no doubt that Huishan's financials are fraudulent.

我们认为辉山在其奶牛场相关的资本支出方面存在造假行为。我们估计，辉山在这些农场上的开支被夸大了8.93亿至16亿元人民币。资本支出造假的主要目的很可能是为了支撑其损益表中的虚假数据。

<!--en-->
We believe Huishan has engaged in CapEx fraud related to its cow farms. We estimate that Huishan has overstated the spending on these farms by RMB 893 million to RMB 1.6 billion. The primary purpose of the CapEx fraud is likely to support the company's income statement fraud.

杨董事长似乎从辉山窃取了至少1.5亿元人民币的资产——实际数额可能更高。此次盗窃行为涉及将一家拥有至少四座奶牛场的子公司未经公告便转让给未披露的关联方。我们很清楚，杨董事长控制着该子公司及这些农场。

<!--en-->
Chairman Yang appears to have stolen at least RMB 150 million of assets from Huishan – the actual number is quite possibly higher. The theft relates to the unannounced transfer of a subsidiary that owned at least four cow farms to an undisclosed related party. It is clear to us that Chairman Yang controls the subsidiary and farms.

即便辉山的财务报表没有造假，由于杠杆率过高，该公司似乎也濒临违约边缘。仅从财务报表表面来看，其信贷指标便十分糟糕。由于杠杆水平极高，在2016财年，辉山的审计师几乎就要出具“持续经营能力存疑”的审计意见。鉴于我们认定辉山所报告的利润存在造假，我们毫不怀疑辉山无法在明年避免违约。目前已有明显迹象表明其面临巨大的财务压力，包括辉山试图采用的融资方式以及停滞的项目。在我们看来，由于虚假利润和现金、估值过高的生物资产以及某些高度可疑的资产科目，辉山资产负债表中的资产项目被严重高估。

<!--en-->
Even if Huishan’s financials were not fraudulent, the company appears to be on the verge of default due to its excessive leverage. Taking Huishan’s financials at face value, its credit metrics are horrible. The leverage is so substantial that in FY16, Huishan’s auditor appears to have stopped just short of issuing a “going concern” qualification. Given that we conclude Huishan’s reported profits are fraudulent, we have no confidence that Huishan can make it through the next year without defaulting. There are clear signs of enormous financial stress, including the types of financing Huishan is trying to employ and halted projects. The asset side of Huishan’s balance sheet, in our opinion, is massively overstated due to fraudulent profits and cash, overvalued biological assets, and certain highly suspicious asset accounts.

尽管与典型的空壳公司相比，辉山乳业拥有“真正的业务”，但其极高的杠杆率使我们得出其股权几乎一文不值的结论。我们认为，辉山乳业的资产价值和报告利润被大幅高估，其现金数额也被严重夸大。这些夸大程度究竟有多严重尚不清楚，很可能还有其他资产科目也存在类似问题。要评估辉山乳业的真实股权价值，就必须了解其账目的真相——而真相在辉山乳业极为稀缺。

<!--en-->
Although Huishan has a “real business” in contrast to a typical Zero, its massive leverage cause us to conclude that its equity is close to worthless. It is our view that Huishan’s asset values and reported profits are inflated by significant amounts, and that its cash is greatly overstated. The extent of these overstatements are unclear, and it is likely there are other asset accounts that are similarly afflicted. Valuing Huishan’s true equity value requires knowing the truth about its accounts – and truth is in short supply at Huishan.

中央结算系统（CCASS）的数据强烈表明，辉山乳业很大一部分流通股已被用作贷款抵押品。如果我们判断正确，一旦借款人无法履行追加保证金的要求，这将对长期持有者构成重大风险。

<!--en-->
CCASS data strongly suggests that a significant portion of Huishan's outstanding shares has been pledged as collateral for loans. If we are correct, this presents a significant risk to long holders if the borrower(s) is / are unable to meet margin calls.

我们对辉山乳业进行了数月调查。在此期间，我们的调查人员走访了35个牧场、5处生产设施（其中一处尚未完工），以及两处已宣布投产但毫无建设迹象的地点。此外，调查人员还对选定的辉山乳业场地进行了无人机航拍。我们聘请了三位乳制品专家，其中两位在中国乳制品行业拥有深厚背景。我们及调查人员还与三个省份的苜蓿供应商和进口商进行了交谈，其中一些供应商向辉山乳业出售苜蓿。另外，我们还对辉山乳业的营业收入进行了详尽的尽职调查，相关内容将在第二部分中讨论。

<!--en-->
We researched Huishan for several months. During this time, our investigators visited 35 farms, five production facilities (including one that was halted mid-construction), and two announced production sites that had no evidence of construction. Additionally, our investigators conducted drone flyovers of selected Huishan sites. We engaged three dairy experts, including two with deep backgrounds in China, dairy farming. We and our investigators spoke with suppliers and importers of alfalfa in three different provinces, some of whom were selling alfalfa to Huishan. In addition, we conducted extensive due diligence into Huishan's topline, which we will discuss in Part 2.

### 通过谎称实现苜蓿自给自足来虚假夸大利润率。

<!--en-->
*Fraudulently Inflating Margins by Falsely Claiming Alfalfa Self-Sufficiency*

我们得出结论：自2014财年以来，辉山通过谎报自身在苜蓿种植上的自给自足情况，欺诈性地虚增了毛利率并虚报利润。辉山将苜蓿生产的自给自足视为其拥有行业领先毛利率的主要驱动力。我们的研究表明，辉山从未在苜蓿生产上实现自给自足；相反，辉山以高于其所称的生产成本的价格从第三方购买大量苜蓿。该公司还声称通过实施饲料成本削减措施来维持利润率，但我们对此表示怀疑。从2016财年起，辉山开始声称自己正在减少苜蓿配比，以便在奶价低迷的环境下降低产奶量。我们认为这一说法站不住脚，反而将其视为掩盖苜蓿造假行为的拙劣尝试。

<!--en-->
We conclude that Huishan has fraudulently inflated its gross margins and reported profits since at least FY14 by lying about being self-sufficient in alfalfa. Huishan cites self-sufficiency in alfalfa production as the main driver of its industry-leading gross margin. Our research indicates that Huishan was never self-sufficient in alfalfa. Instead Huishan has bought substantial quantities of alfalfa from third parties at higher prices than its claimed production costs. The company also claims to preserve margins by implementing a feed cost reduction effort that we find dubious. Starting in FY16, Huishan began claiming that it is decreasing alfalfa ratios to engineer lower milk yields in an environment of depressed prices. We do not believe this holds water, and instead view it as a ham-fisted attempt to unwind the alfalfa fraud.

### 什么是苜蓿？

<!--en-->
*What is alfalfa?*

苜蓿是一种富含蛋白质和维生素的牧草，能够提升产奶量和乳蛋白含量，而后者正是生鲜乳售价的关键决定因素。它也是辉山备受吹捧的“从草到奶”全产业链模式中的核心原料。$ ^{1} $

<!--en-->
Alfalfa is a protein and vitamin rich grass that boosts milk yield and protein content, a key determinant in the selling price of raw milk. It is the “grass” in Huishan’s much-heralded fully integrated “Grass to Glass” model. $ ^{1} $

### 辉山宣称自己在苜蓿生产上实现了自给自足。

<!--en-->
*Huishan has claimed to be self-sufficient in producing alfalfa*

早在2013财年，辉山就通过报告苜蓿作物盈余来暗示其在苜蓿生产上的自给自足能力。$ ^{1} $ 下面这张来自辉山2015财年年报演示文稿的幻灯片再次重复了这一说法。$ ^{2} $

<!--en-->
Huishan implied self-sufficiency in alfalfa as early as FY13 by reporting an alfalfa crop surplus. $ ^{1} $ The slide below from Huishan's FY15 annual presentation repeats this claim. $ ^{2} $

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//a936f788-4db3-45c9-b3f0-945c19f3c19a/markdown_0/imgs/img_in_image_box_497_158_741_527.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A44%3A58Z%2F-1%2F%2Faa2022d416f84882f45df358200c4e1d6a931f4601b35cfbf814850caf4eb906" alt="Image" width="19%" /></div>

<div style="text-align: center;"><div style="text-align: center;">Huishan's purported alfalfa self-sufficiency is the cornerstone of its margins</div> </div>

由于辉山实际上一直在从第三方采购大量苜蓿，其利润被大幅虚增。辉山声称自己在苜蓿生产上实现自给自足，因此报告了极高的利润率，理由是无需向第三方供应商购买苜蓿或安排长途运输。$ ^{3}$ 在其IPO招股说明书中，辉山称自身的生产成本为70元/吨（约合人民币437元/吨），而进口苜蓿的成本约为400元/吨（约合人民币2,500元/吨）。辉山强调，其苜蓿农场靠近饲料加工企业和奶牛场，因此在物流成本和产品质量方面具有优势。$ ^{4}$ 较短的供应链据说还能更好地保留苜蓿中的蛋白质含量，否则这些蛋白质会在运输和储存过程中流失。$ ^{5}$ 根据2014财年的产量数据，我们估算出辉山因采用短供应链而节省的苜蓿成本在8,300万元至1.1亿元之间（相当于600元至800元/吨）。$^{6}$

<!--en-->
Because Huishan has in fact been purchasing substantial quantities of alfalfa from third parties, its profits have been fraudulently overstated by a massive amount. By claiming to be self-sufficient in alfalfa production, Huishan has reported outsize margins by purportedly not having to purchase alfalfa from third party vendors or arranging long-haul transportation. $ ^{3} $ In its IPO prospectus, Huishan claimed its own production costs were 70/mt (approximately RMB 437/mt), versus approximately 400/mt (approximately RMB 2,500/mt) for imported alfalfa. Huishan emphasized logistics cost and quality advantages of having their alfalfa farms close to its feed processing companies and dairy farms. $ ^{4} $ The short supply chain also supposedly meant improved retention of the grass’ protein content that otherwise is degraded during transportation and handling. $ ^{5} $ We estimated Huishan reported a cost savings of a short supply chain for alfalfa to be RMB 83 to 110 million (RMB 600 to 800/mt) based on FY14 reported production volumes. $ ^{6} $

辉山对所谓已收获的苜蓿作物确认了生物性收益。如下表所示，2013财年至2016财年间，苜蓿带来的生物性收益占辉山税前利润的19%至24%。这种低廉的生产成本促使其在2011财年至2013财年间将乳制品业务板块的利润率从42.7%提升至59.8%。$^{7}$ 2013年，一家大型投资银行估计，辉山的苜蓿种植园为其乳制品业务贡献了22%的现金EBITDA（不包括生物性损失）。

<!--en-->
Huishan has booked biological gains on purported harvested alfalfa crops. As shown below, from FY13 through FY16, bio-gains from alfalfa comprised 19% to 24% of Huishan's pre-tax profits. These low production costs were the catalyst for improving margins in its dairy farming business segment from 42.7% to 59.8% during FY11 to FY13. $ ^{7} $ In 2013, a major investment bank estimated that Huishan's alfalfa plantations contributed 22% of cash EBITDA (excluding biological losses) to its dairy farming business.

辉山似乎试图通过上报不断上升的苜蓿生产成本来削弱其虚报的利润率。苜蓿生产成本从2013年的70元/吨（约合人民币422元/吨）上升至2014年的92元/吨（约合人民币579元/吨），2015年又进一步上涨16%至107元/吨（约人民币656元/吨）。$^{8910}$ 根据该公司的生物资产估值表，我们估算出辉山在2016财年的苜蓿成本增加了14%，达到122美元/吨（约人民币773元/吨）。

<!--en-->
Huishan appears to be trying to take some of the air out of the fraudulent margins by reporting escalating alfalfa production costs. Alfalfa production costs rose 31% from 70/mt (approx. RMB 422/mt) in 2013 to 92/mt (approx. RMB 579/mt) in 2014 and another 16% to 107/mt (approximately RMB 656/mt) in 2015. $ ^{8910} $ From the company's bio asset valuation tables, we estimate that Huishan booked a 14% per ton increase in FY16 to US122/mt (approximately RMB 773/mt).

###  $ \underline{\text{Huishan lied about being self-sufficient in alfalfa}} $

至少从2014财年起，辉山就一直在谎报其苜蓿自给能力。$ ^{1112} $

<!--en-->
Huishan has been lying about being self-sufficient in alfalfa likely since at least FY14. $ ^{1112} $

- 我们的调查人员发现辉山使用的是从美国进口的Anderson Hay & Grain Company生产的苜蓿。$^{13}$ Anderson公司在中国的代理商证实，自2013年以来辉山一直是其主要客户。

<!--en-->
- Our investigators found Huishan using Anderson Hay & Grain Company alfalfa imported from the U.S. $ ^{13} $ Anderson's China agent confirmed that Huishan has been a significant client since 2013.

九个农场的工作人员证实，辉山从海外及黑龙江地区的第三方处采购苜蓿。

<!--en-->
Employees at nine farms confirmed that Huishan purchases alfalfa from third parties overseas and in Heilongjiang.

- 一位黑龙江地区的苜蓿分销商也证实，其公司与辉山有着长期的供货关系，为辉山供应牧草和苜蓿。

- 辉山的一家“示范农场”内有一块标牌写明，该农场用从美国进口的苜蓿喂养奶牛。

<!--en-->
- A Heilongjiang alfalfa distributor also confirmed that his company has a longstanding relationship to supply Huishan with sheep grass and alfalfa.

- A sign at one of Huishan's “show farms” states that it feeds the cows with alfalfa imported from the U.S.

一位曾在2014年对辉山进行尽职调查的投资人向我们提供了其调查人员在辉山农场拍摄的照片，照片显示辉山确实在用美国El Toro公司生产的苜蓿喂牛。

<!--en-->
An investor who diligenced Huishan in 2014 provided us with photographs his investigators took on Huishan farms that show it was feeding U.S. alfalfa produced by El Toro.

- 从表面上看，鉴于辉山农场所在的辽宁地区存在洪水灾害，其宣称的苜蓿产量令人难以置信。

<!--en-->
- On the surface, Huishan's purported alfalfa production is hard to believe, given the flooding issues in Liaoning where it has its farms.

我们发现辉山所报告的苜蓿产量存在疑点——自上市以来，其每头奶牛的苜蓿消耗量急剧下降，这再次印证了我们的结论：辉山关于苜蓿产量的说法纯属虚假。

<!--en-->
We spotted a red flag in Huishan's reported alfalfa production – its alfalfa production per head has decreased precipitously since its IPO, once again supporting our conclusion that Huishan's alfalfa claims are false.

我们的调查人员发现辉山是Anderson公司的重要客户。看来Anderson公司提供的苜蓿数量大约相当于辉山所宣称的2014财年苜蓿产量的一半。我们的调查人员在辉山农场拍摄了以下照片。

<!--en-->
Our investigators discovered Huishan has been a significant customer of Anderson. It appears Anderson supplied quantities approximately equal to half of Huishan's purported FY14 alfalfa production. Our investigators took the below photograph at a Huishan farm.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//a936f788-4db3-45c9-b3f0-945c19f3c19a/markdown_2/imgs/img_in_image_box_178_731_1044_1005.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A01Z%2F-1%2F%2F05fe9795aadbc3bd50813d705bb1464a547f1d7b14a9bf84e5c3c9a75466b295" alt="Image" width="70%" /></div>

我们联系了Anderson公司在中国的进口商/代理商，对方证实辉山已成为其客户三年之久。据该代理商称，辉山从Anderson公司进货始于2013年，当年进货量约为70,000吨；2014年和2015年因中国奶业市场疲软，进货量降至每年30,000–40,000吨；2016年这一数字略有回升。仅2013年Anderson公司提供的苜蓿量就相当于辉山2014财年（2013年4月1日至2014年3月31日）报告的内部消费总量的一半左右。该进口商/代理商还提供了当前市场价格信息：大连港交货价为2,330元人民币/吨（约合345美元）。$^{14}$

<!--en-->
We contacted Anderson’s importer/agent in China, who confirmed that Huishan has been a customer for three years. According to the agent, Huishan’s shipments from Anderson started in 2013 with approximately 70,000 mt that year, dropped to 30,000-40,000 mt/yr in 2014 and 2015 when the China milk market softened, and that volume improved modestly in 2016. The reported volumes supplied by Anderson in 2013 alone equate to about half of Huishan’s FY14 (April 1, 2013 to March 31, 2014) reported total internal consumption. The importer/agent also provided current market prices, quoting RMB 2,330/mt (approximately US345) based on delivery at the port of Dalian. $ ^{14} $

辉山也从第三方采购国产苜蓿。一位黑龙江地区的分销商证实，他们已为该公司供应苜蓿和牧草多年，且与该公司的采购经理关系甚好。$^{15}$

<!--en-->
Huishan purchases domestic alfalfa from third parties as well. A Heilongjiang distributor confirmed that they have been supplying the Company with alfalfa and sheep grass for several years and have very good “guanxi” with the Company’s purchasing manager. $ ^{15} $

辉山农场上的标识与其申报内容进一步相悖。参观该公司某座“示范农场”的游客会被告知，那里饲养的小牛喂食的是从美国进口的优质苜蓿。

<!--en-->
Signage on Huishan's farms further contradicts its filings. Visitors to one of the company's "show farms" are told calves raised there are fed premium alfalfa imported from the US.

一位在2014年对辉山进行过详尽尽职调查的投资人向我们提供了可佐证调查人员工作的信息。我们得知，2014年该投资人的调查人员走访了七座农场，这些农场共饲养约16,000头奶牛。调查人员报告称，这些农场大量使用进口苜蓿，甚至完全依赖进口苜蓿。$ ^{16} $ 他们的照片显示，这些苜蓿仍保持着来自美国最大苜蓿出口商之一El Toro公司的出口包装。$ ^{17} $ （由于我们并未亲自聘请这些调查人员，我们仅将他们的成果作为佐证我们自身研究的证据。我们认为该投资人及其尽职调查工作具有可信度，但我们无法保证其研究的准确性。）

<!--en-->
An investor who conducted extensive due diligence on Huishan in 2014 gave us information that corroborates our investigators' work. We were told that in 2014, the investor's investigators visited seven farms with about 16,000 cows in total. The investigators reported these farms used imported alfalfa extensively, if not exclusively. $ ^{16} $ Their photos show imported alfalfa in its export wrapping from El Toro, one of the US's largest alfalfa exporters. $ ^{17} $ (Because we did not engage these investigators ourselves, we only cite their work product as evidence that corroborates our own research. We believe the investor and their diligence work are credible, but we cannot attest to the accuracy of their research.)

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//4442d890-6b0d-4eb8-9c0d-c6acb1a7067e/markdown_0/imgs/img_in_image_box_339_503_884_910.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A44%3A57Z%2F-1%2F%2Ff9959d55858ed9769ca02d6476d37323d57a02e0bc4c95abe9e4aef52b068574" alt="Image" width="44%" /></div>

<div style="text-align: center;"><div style="text-align: center;">Bales of El Toro alfalfa on a Huishan farm. Photographs taken in 2014 by investigators dispatched by another investor.</div> </div>

我们认为，辉山无法种植出满足自身需求的足量苜蓿的原因之一是东北地区并不适合种植这种作物。尽管辉山宣称辽宁是“最适宜种植苜蓿的地区之一”，但该地区的气候却带来了严峻挑战。$ ^{18} $ 辉山的许多苜蓿农场位于辽宁的长土乡。$ ^{19} $ 2014年1月关于长土乡租给辉山的土地纠纷的法院判决凸显了这些问题：被告指出在该地区从事农业风险极高，且过去十年间辽河多次淹没所租赁的土地。$ ^{20} $

<!--en-->
We believe one reason that Huishan cannot grow enough alfalfa for its needs is that northeastern China isn’t a good area for this crop. Despite touting Liaoning as “one of the most suitable planting areas for alfalfa growing,” the region’s climate poses stark challenges. $ ^{18} $ Many of Huishan’s alfalfa farms are in Chang Tu Township in Liaoning. $ ^{19} $ A January 2014 court judgment regarding a dispute in Chang Tu over fields leased to Huishan highlights these issues: a defendant pointed out that farming in that area was risky and that over a ten-year period the Liao river flooded the leased parcel numerous times. $ ^{20} $

这位第三方投资人的调查人员于2014年冬季走访了长土乡。他们称与当地农民交谈时得知，辉山的农田因

<!--en-->
The third party investor's investigators visited Chang Tu in the winter of 2014. They reported having conversations with local farmers who reported serious damage to Huishan's fields from

2013年夏季的洪水遭受严重破坏，估计导致农作物损失达4,000万元人民币。$ ^{21} $ 2014年夏季，苜蓿农场又遭遇了严重的干旱，再次影响了生产。$ ^{22} $

<!--en-->
flooding in summer 2013, which caused an estimated crop loss of RMB 40 million. $ ^{21} $ In summer 2014, the alfalfa farms reportedly suffered debilitating drought, again impacting production. $ ^{22} $

报告的苜蓿产量与奶牛存栏量的比例揭示了辉山所谓自给自足说法的虚假性。自IPO以来，供给与需求的增长率明显背离。过去四年中，可挤奶牛数量翻了一番，小牛数量几乎增加了两倍，但年度产量和种植面积却未能跟上步伐。

<!--en-->
The ratio of reported alfalfa production to herd size belies Huishan's claims of self-sufficiency. Since the IPO, the growth rates of supply and demand have diverged markedly. While the reported number of milkable cows doubled and the number of calves nearly tripled over the past four years, annual production and acreage under cultivation failed to keep pace.

根据公司公布的产量、盈余以及小牛和可挤奶牛存栏量数据，按每头奶牛计算的可用苜蓿消费量显示：自2013财年起，可供可挤奶牛食用的自产苜蓿量（公斤/天）逐年下降。2014财年自产苜蓿供应量同比减少约9%，2015财年减少24%，2016财年则减少53%。如下面的图表所示，辉山2015年（2016财年）的苜蓿产量较2013财年绝对数值下降了25%，且自IPO以来按每头可挤奶牛计算的产量每年都在下降。

<!--en-->
A calculation of alfalfa available for consumption on a per head basis (based on the Company’s production, surplus, and calf and milkable cow herd size numbers) indicates that from FY13, the available quantity of self-produced alfalfa for milkable cows (kg/day) declined each year. The available ration of self-grown alfalfa declined year-on-year by about 9% in FY14, 24% in FY15, and 53% in FY16. As the following chart shows, Huishan’s reported 2015 (FY16) alfalfa production is down 25% on an absolute basis from FY13, and declined every year on a per head of milkable cow basis since its IPO.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//4442d890-6b0d-4eb8-9c0d-c6acb1a7067e/markdown_2/imgs/img_in_chart_box_204_231_994_939.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A44%3A59Z%2F-1%2F%2Fe52e03398b8d00429ff956f6f2030a567760af604c687492f5e195fbfe78c513" alt="Image" width="64%" /></div>

我们认为，辉山试图通过声称调整饲料配方来掩盖其产量造假行为。如果公司真的在减少产量，那么辉山将会因此亏损并压缩其报表上的利润率。因此，我们将这一说法视为逃避揭露其造假行为的一种手段。面对原奶平均销售价格的下跌，辉山声称通过降低饲料成本来提高利润率，而原奶产量仅略有下降（2015财年为9.1吨，2016财年为8.6吨）。$ ^{23} $ 在2016年11月底发布的中期报告中，辉山宣布故意将牛奶产量降至7.8吨，“以进一步降低原奶成本并控制生产规模。”$ ^{24} $

<!--en-->
We believe Huishan is trying to unwind its yield fraud by claiming changes to its feed mix. If the company were actually reducing yields, Huishan would be losing money in doing so and shrinking its reported margins. Therefore, we see this claim as a way to try to avoid exposure of its fraud. Facing declining raw milk ASPs, Huishan claimed to boost profit margins by reducing feed costs, with just a minor drop in raw milk yields (9.1 in FY15 vs. 8.6 in FY16). $ ^{23} $ In its interim report published in late November 2016, Huishan announced that it deliberately lowered milk yields to 7.8 tons “to further reduce the cost of raw milk and control our production volume.” $ ^{24} $

### 通过降低饲料成本来提高利润率的说法缺乏可信度。

<!--en-->
*Claim of Boosting Margins by Reducing Feed Costs Lacks Credence*

每日每头可挤奶牛可用苜蓿估算量（公斤）

<!--en-->
Est. of Available Alfalafa (kgs) / Milkable Cow / Day

我们咨询过的中国和美国乳业专家均质疑此类做法的逻辑性、明智程度及商业可行性。他们指出，这与过去十年中采用的最佳实践背道而驰，

<!--en-->
Chinese and American dairy experts with whom we spoke dispute the logic, wisdom, and commercial feasibility of such action. They noted that it runs counter to best practices utilized

极有可能导致盈利能力的下降。2006年一项关于改变饲料配方对边际成本和盈利能力影响的研究作者发现：“盲目追求降低投入成本往往会错失重要的盈利机会”，并且“刻意限制泌乳奶牛的能量摄入在财务上绝非明智之举。”$ ^{25} $

<!--en-->
for the past decade, and would most likely result in a decline in profitability. The authors of a study in 2006 on the impacts of marginal cost and profitability by altering the quality of the feed ration found that “significant profit opportunities can be lost in the false pursuit of reducing input costs” and that “it is unlikely…that it is ever financially wise to deliberately limit the energy intake of a milking dairy cow.” $ ^{25} $

我们对辉山公布的财务数据进行分析后发现：因销售损失导致的收入减少超过了调整饲料配方所带来的成本节约，这一结果与专家意见相符。辉山在2015财年拥有74,389头可挤奶牛，饲料成本为9.461亿人民币；2016财年则拥有96,339头可挤奶牛，饲料成本增至10.50029亿人民币。²⁶尽管该公司声称每头牛每年可节省1,646人民币的饲料成本，但每头牛的销售额却减少了2,208人民币，这意味着每头牛的净边际损失达到562人民币。

<!--en-->
Our analysis of financial data reported by Huishan shows that revenue decreases from lost sales exceed the cost savings from altering feed rations, corroborating these expert opinions. Huishan reported 74,389 milkable cows and feed cost of RMB 946,100,000 in FY15, and 96,339 milkable cows and feed cost of RMB 1,050,029,000 in FY16. $ ^{26} $ While the company purportedly saved RMB 1,646 in annual feed costs per cow, it lost RMB 2,208 in sales per cow, which equals a net marginal loss of RMB 562 per cow.

### 我们估计惠山膨胀型奶牛场的资本开支可能高达16亿元人民币。

<!--en-->
*We Estimate Huishan Inflated Dairy Farm CapEx by as Much as RMB 1.6 Billion*

我们估计，自上市以来，辉山乳业将奶牛场建设的资本支出虚报了8.93亿至16亿元人民币。我们的结论基于调查人员对上市后开工或完工的17个辉山奶牛场的实地考察、对政府记录的详尽研究以及行业专家的咨询。夸大资本支出是欺诈行为的典型特征。当一家公司虚报利润时，就会出现“虚假现金问题”。大多数审计所采用的唯一反欺诈手段就是现金确认程序。尽管中国许多欺诈案件都伪造了现金余额，但要做到这一点并非易事。因此，欺诈者往往倾向于购买资产并虚报支付金额，以此作为他们实际上并未拥有报表所暗示的现金的理由。在我们看来，辉山乳业虚报资本支出的方式与此模式相符。

<!--en-->
We estimate that since its IPO, Huishan inflated CapEx for dairy farm construction by RMB 893 million to RMB 1.6 billion. Our conclusions are based on our investigators visiting 17 Huishan cow farms started or completed since the IPO, extensive research of government records, and consulting industry experts. Overstating CapEx is typical for frauds. When a company reports fake profits, it has a “fake cash problem.” The only anti-fraud device most audits employ is cash confirmation. Although many frauds in China have forged cash balances, it can be challenging to do so. As a result, frauds tend to buy assets and over-report the amounts they paid. This gives them an excuse for not actually having the cash their reported profits imply. In our opinion, Huishan is inflating its CapEx in a manner consistent with this pattern.

由于辉山并未明确披露其建设奶牛场所花费的金额，我们不得不进行估算。辉山的招股说明书似乎试图误导投资者，让他们误以为该公司计划为每个奶牛场投入约4520万人民币。然而，我们估计从2014财年到2016财年，辉山为其建造的32个奶牛场所记录的支出约为每个农场8900万人民币——总计30亿人民币。$ ^{27}$ 我们认为辉山实际可能花费的金额远低于这一数字。此外，在多个场合……

<!--en-->
Because Huishan does not expressly disclose the amounts it spends on constructing dairy farms, we have to estimate it. Huishan's prospectus seems to attempt to mislead investors into believing that the company planned to spend approximately RMB 45.2 million per farm. However, we estimate that from FY14 to FY16, Huishan booked approximately RMB 89 million for each of the 32 farms it built – totaling RMB 3.0 billion. $ ^{27} $ We believe the actual amount Huishan could have expended is substantially less than that amount. Furthermore, on several

我们几次发现挤奶农场缺少挤奶设备，导致生产不完整，这再次让我们对迄今为止投入的资本性支出总额产生疑问。

<!--en-->
occasions we encountered milking farms lacking milking equipment, and thus incomplete, again leading us to question the total amount of CapEx deployed to-date.

辉山对其奶牛场的资本支出讳莫如深。

<!--en-->
Huishan is cagey about its dairy farm CapEx spending.

辉山在奶牛场的资本支出方面向来遮遮掩掩。虽然招股说明书中并未列出平均建设成本，但已披露的募集资金用途似乎表明，这45个新牧场的平均资本支出将达到每座牧场4520万元人民币，其中包括土地、建筑、机械及设备费用。（这一数字与我们咨询的行业专家所认为的牧场可能成本范围相符。）

<!--en-->
Huishan has always been opaque about its dairy farm CapEx. While the IPO prospectus excludes an average construction cost, the disclosed use of proceeds appeared to indicate that the average CapEx for the 45 new farms would be RMB 45.2 million per farm including land, construction, machinery, and equipment. (This figure is in line with what industry experts that we consulted consider to be the likely cost range of its farms.)

Source: Prospectus, Use of Proceeds, pp. 270-271

招股说明书似乎为辉山乳业在奶牛场建设上投入更多资金留出了余地。招股说明书的其他部分还显示，辉山乳业声称自己有补充资金计划用于奶牛场建设。在与关联方交易相关的段落中，该公司称建成五个奶牛场的总预计支出约为每座8900万港元（约合7000万元人民币），这一数字远远超出了招股说明书中披露的募集资金数额。不过，整个招股说明书中关于未来支出资金来源的表述并不一致。在许多地方，招股说明书明确指出IPO募集资金将是唯一的资金来源。类似如下的表述

<!--en-->
The prospectus seems to give Huishan the wiggle room to spend substantially more on dairy farms. Elsewhere in the prospectus, Huishan indicates that it supposedly has supplemental funds it plans to add to the spend on dairy farms. In a paragraph related to Connected Party Transactions, the company states that the total planned expenditure to complete five farms would be around HKD$ 89 million each (~RMB 70 million), which exceeds by a large margin the amount implied using Proceeds disclosure. However, throughout the Prospectus the wording on disclosures for the sources of funds for future expenditure varies. In many places, the Prospectus specifies when the IPO proceeds will be the sole source of funding. Language like

在有关新建36万吨/年液态奶厂、3.3万吨/年奶粉厂以及在辽宁建设的两座饲料加工厂的披露中反复出现：$ ^{29} $

<!--en-->
the below is repeated in disclosures relating to intended expenditures for new 360,000 tpa liquid milk plant, the 33,000 tpa milk powder plant, and two feeds processing plants to be built in Liaoning: $ ^{29} $

约3%，即2亿港元将用于建设位于辽宁省的两座饲料加工厂，其年产能分别为10万吨（预计支出9400万港元）和20万吨（预计支出1.06亿港元），这两座工厂预计将分别于截至2016年3月31日和2017年3月31日的年度内完工。我们计划完全用全球发售所得的净款项来资助该建设计划。

<!--en-->
Approximately 3%, or HK$200 million will be used for constructing two feeds processing plants in Liaoning Province with annual capacity of 100,000 tonnes (expected expenditure to be HK$94 million) and 200,000 tonnes (expected expenditure to be HK$106 million), respectively, which are expected to be completed during the years ending March 31, 2016 and March 31, 2017, respectively. We expect to fund the construction plan entirely by the net proceeds from the Global Offering.

在讨论奶牛场建设的募集资金用途时，却并未出现“完全依靠发售所得款项”这样的措辞，这就为单个奶牛场的资本性支出超过披露的IPO募集资金数额留下了空间。

<!--en-->
The “entirely” through offering proceeds verbiage is notably absent in discussion of the use for proceeds for dairy farm construction, opening the door to per farm CapEx exceeding the disclosed use of IPO proceeds.

约34%，即24亿港元将用于在今后三年内于辽宁省建设45个新奶牛场。具体而言，我们计划在截至2014年3月31日、2015年3月31日及2016年3月31日的年度内分别建立5个、18个和22个奶牛场，预计支出分别约为2.67亿港元、9.6亿港元和11.73亿港元。其中，在截至2014年3月31日的年度内，我们计划花费3400万港元购置土地，1.94亿港元用于奶牛场建设，3900万港元用于购置设备与机械；在截至2015年3月31日的年度内，计划花费1.22亿港元购置土地，6.68亿港元用于奶牛场建设，1.7亿港元用于购置设备与机械；在截至2016年3月31日的年度内，计划花费1.5亿港元购置土地，8.06亿港元用于奶牛场建设，2.17亿港元用于购置设备与机械。

<!--en-->
Approximately 34%, or HK$2.4 billion will be used for constructing 45 new dairy farms located in Liaoning Province in the coming three years. In particular, we plan to establish 5, 18 and 22 dairy farms for the years ending March 31, 2014, 2015 and 2016, with expected expenditure of approximately HK$267 million, HK$960 million and HK$1,173 million, respectively. In particular, for the year ending March 31, 2014, we plan to spend HK$34 million to acquire land, HK$194 million to construct the dairy farm and HK$39 million to acquire the equipment and machinery. For the year ending March 31, 2015, we plan to spend HK$122 million to acquire land, HK$668 million to construct the dairy farm and HK$170 million to acquire the equipment and machinery. For the year ending March 31, 2016, we plan to spend HK$150 million to acquire land, HK$806 million to construct the dairy farm and HK$217 million to acquire the equipment and machinery.

我们估计，从2014财年到2016财年，辉山乳业每个奶牛场的资本性支出约为8900万元人民币；2016财年的资本性支出似乎已飙升至1.07亿元人民币。

<!--en-->
We estimate that from FY14 through FY16, Huishan booked CapEx of RMB 89 million per dairy farm; FY16 CapEx appears to have ballooned to RMB 107 million.

根据辉山乳业的现金流量披露信息，我们估计其在2014财年至2016财年间每个奶牛场的平均资本性支出为8900万元人民币。我们估计2016财年该平均支出达到了1.07亿元人民币。如果我们的估算基本准确，2016财年的支出增加很可能与辉山乳业日益严峻的财务压力有关。政府发布的环境影响评估报告支持了我们的三年平均值估算：主要生产原奶的奶牛场每座总投资为9000万元至9990万元人民币，而主要用于繁育和饲养犊牛的奶牛场（无需挤奶设备且配套设施较少）每座投资则为6400万元至8100万元人民币。

<!--en-->
From Huishan's cashflow disclosures, we estimate Huishan booked average dairy farm CapEx spend of RMB 89 million during FY14 through FY16. We estimate that in FY16, Huishan booked average spend of RMB 107 million. If our estimates are generally correct, the increase in FY16 likely is related to Huishan's increasing financial stress. Government environmental impact reports support our three-year average estimate, showing total investments of RMB 90 million to 99.9 million per each farm that principally produces raw milk, and RMB 64 million to RMB 81 million for farms principally engaged in breeding and raising calves (which require no milking equipment and fewer amenities).

我们利用辉山乳业的现金流量披露数据来估算奶牛场的平均资本性支出。辉山乳业的年报详细说明了用于物业、厂房及设备支出的现金流情况，并在分部报告中列出了具体的资本性支出明细。根据公司提供的数据，我们估算了2014财年至2016财年间已建成的32个奶牛场在物业、厂房及设备方面的资本性支出。计算结果显示，在这三年期间，每个奶牛场在物业、厂房及设备方面的平均宣称资本性支出很可能为8900万元人民币，我们认为这一数字属于偏低/对公司有利估算。

<!--en-->
We use Huishan's cash flow disclosures to estimate average dairy farm CapEx spend. Huishan's annual reports provide detail on cash flow utilized for PP&E expenditures and breaks out capital expenditures in its segment reporting. Using Company-supplied data we estimated the CapEx dedicated to PP&E for the 32 farms reportedly built from FY14 through FY16. These calculations show that over the three-year period the average claimed CapEx spend for PP&E per dairy farm was very likely RMB 89 million, which we believe is a low / company favorable estimate.

我们首先从用于购置物业、厂房及设备的现金流中，扣除液态奶和奶粉加工环节（即加工厂）的资本性支出，以及机动车辆的物业、厂房及设备费用。这样便能单独分离出奶牛养殖业务相关的物业、厂房及设备。奶牛养殖业务仍涵盖种植作业、饲料加工以及奶牛养殖；因此，我们根据年度募集资金用途说明中公布的变化情况来估算饲料加工厂的物业、厂房及设备规模（这些资金将完全来自首次公开募股所得款项$^{30}$），并估算种植园所需的额外物业、厂房及设备规模，将其定为首次公开募股所列设备采购费用的一半。随后，我们将在建工程的变化因素重新计入总额，从而得出已建成农场物业、厂房及设备的总资本性支出估算值。

<!--en-->
We first deduct the segment CapEx for liquid milk and milk powder processing (the processing plants) as well as the PPE expense for motor vehicles from the cash flows utilized for PP&E. This isolates the PP&E for the dairy farming segment. The dairy farming segment still includes plantation operations, feed processing, as well as dairy farming; therefore, we estimate the PP&E for feed processing plants based on the changes announced in the annual use of proceeds statement (which was to be funded entirely from the IPO proceeds $ ^{30} $) and estimate the additional PP&E for the plantations as being half of that used for the procurement of the equipment listed in the IPO. The changes in construction in process were then factored back into the total, providing an estimate for the total CapEx for PP&E on completed farms.

我们认为这一估算较为保守，原因如下：

<!--en-->
We consider this estimate to be conservative because:

附注1：种植园建筑的固定资产并未具体披露。我们基于饲料加工厂与种植园建筑费用2:1的比例来估算该数值；因为我们相信加工厂所需的资本支出会远高于种植园中的畜舍、仓储及办公设施。在2016财年，公司并未扩建种植园，因此很可能没有新的建设活动；故而相关费用在2014财年和2015财年各占45%，而在2016财年仅占10%。2017年上半年，公司报告的种植园面积减少了9万亩。如果公司预见到这种可能性，2016财年的新投资很可能会被进一步削减。

<!--en-->
Note 1: The PPE for plantation buildings is not specifically disclosed. We estimate it based on a 2:1 ratio of feed processing plants to plantation building expense as we believe that the processing plant will require much greater CapEx than the plantation farm sheds, storage, and office spaces. In FY16 no expansion of the plantations took place, so it is likely that no new construction took place; therefore, the allocation of the expense was 45% to each of FY14 and FY15, and just 10% to FY16. In 1H17, the Company reported a decrease in plantation lands of 90,000 mu. If the Company had considered this a possibility, new investments in FY16 would very likely have been further curtailed.

- 工厂的资本性支出包括物业、厂房及设备（PP&E）以及土地租赁费用。由于PP&E不包括土地，仅用于建造工厂的支出会低于工厂资本性支出的总额。这对公司而言是有利的，因为这可能会高估工厂相关的PP&E支出金额，从而导致对每家奶牛场的估算值偏低。

- 在建工程（CIP）的变化涵盖了工厂部分，但我们假定所有CIP均用于奶牛场。同样，机动车辆既包括农业用途也包括非农业用途；我们假定该类别下的所有固定资产均应用于奶牛场。这对公司而言是有利的，因为这种做法可能会低估分配给工厂的CIP金额，从而导致对单个奶牛场的估算值偏低。

<!--en-->
- The CapEx for plants includes both PP&E and land lease payments. Because PP&E excludes land, the additions for constructing the plants alone would be lower than the total CapEx for plants. This is company favorable because it likely overestimates the amount of PP&E spending for plants, and thus results in a lower per dairy farm estimate.

- The changes in Construction in Process (CIP) includes that for plants, however we adopted assumption that all CIP was for the dairy farms. Likewise, motor vehicles include farm and non-farm operations. We assume all PP&E in this category apply to dairy farms. This is company favorable because it likely underestimates the amount of CIP allocated to plants, and thus results in a lower per dairy farm estimate.

在2016财年，非奶牛场领域的投资与建设活动有所减少，没有新增饲料种植用地；沈北工厂已竣工，江苏工厂也接近完工，因此对加工厂的投资大幅缩减。2016财年，辉山乳业共建成13座运营中的奶牛场。根据2016财年的数据，我们计算出每个奶牛场的平均资本性支出约为1.07亿元人民币（见下表3），这表明2016财年奶牛场的资本性支出有所上升——这可能是由于辉山乳业面临的财务压力所致（参见《辉山乳业的流动性已岌岌可危：其资产存疑，且其所公布的2017年上半年现金流数据极有可能是虚假的》）。

<!--en-->
In FY16, there was less non-dairy farm investment and construction activity, no feed plantations lands were added, the Shenbei plant was finished, and the Jiangsu plant was also nearly complete, so investments in processing plants were considerably smaller. In FY16, Huishan completed 13 operational dairy farms. Based on FY16 numbers, we calculated an average per farm CapEx spend of approximately RMB 107 million (see Table 3 below), suggesting that the dairy farm CapEx inflation increased in FY16 – possibly due to Huishan's financial stress (see Huishan's Liquidity Appears to be on the Knife's Edge, it has Dubious Assets, and its Reported 1H17 Cash Flow is Almost Certainly Fraudulent).

辽宁省政府的文件与我们的估算相符。我们对2014年和2015年公开的辽宁省环境影响报告进行审阅后发现，辉山乳业多次声称其新建牧场的总投资额与我们通过现金流分析得出的数值处于同一范围。这些报告中列出的各主要生产原奶的牧场预计总投资额为9000万元人民币至9990万元人民币（其中应包含约500万元至600万元人民币的土地租赁费用）。而对于主要用于繁育和饲养犊牛的牧场，预计投资额为6400万元人民币至8100万元人民币。我们认为，辉山乳业在这些报告中填报了虚高的数字，目的是获取地方政府更多支持，并为其向审计师提供的资本支出数据提供依据。

<!--en-->
Liaoning government documents accord with our estimates. Our review of publicly accessible Liaoning Province environmental impact reports from 2014 and 2015 found numerous instances where Huishan appears to have made claims of building new farms with total investments in the same range as that identified from our cash flow analysis. The reports list projected total investments for individual farms principally producing raw milk of RMB 90 million to 99.9 million (which should include the land leases of approximately RMB 5 million to RMB 6 million). Reports for farms that are principally breeding and raising calves projected spending of RMB 64 million to RMB 81 million. We believe Huishan reported inflated numbers for these reports to win greater support from local officials, and to support the CapEx numbers it provides its auditor.

我们得出结论：辉山乳业每个奶牛场的实际支出远低于我们所估算的其上报数值$ \underline{\text{spend}} $。

<!--en-->
We conclude that Huishan's real spend per dairy farm is substantially lower than our estimates of its reported  $ \underline{\text{spend}} $.

我们咨询了两位对中国奶牛场建设成本有 firsthand 了解的中国奶牛场专家，以协助估算辉山乳业的实际奶牛场建设成本。我们向他们提供了调查人员走访的七座上市后建设的奶牛场的照片和视频。$ ^{31} $ 专家A认为，辉山乳业在每个挤奶牧场上的最高支出可能仅为6000万元人民币（假设为拥有3000头奶牛的牧场）。专家B则认为此类牧场的最高支出可能仅为3500万元人民币。根据我们估算的上报奶牛场建设成本，这些估计表明自上市以来，辉山乳业平均奶牛场资本支出被高估了三分之一（约2900万元人民币）到一半以上（约5400万元人民币）。我们关于实际建设成本远低于通过PP&E支出分析所得结果的判断得到了以下人员的证实：一座上市后建设的牧场的管理人员、一座正在建设中的牧场的承包商，以及另外两座上市后建设的牧场的招标文件。

<!--en-->
We consulted two China dairy farm experts with first-hand knowledge of farm construction costs to assist in estimating Huishan’s actual dairy farm construction costs. We provided them with photos and videos from seven post-IPO dairy farms our investigators visited. $ ^{31} $ Expert A opined that the maximum Huishan spent per milking farm was only likely RMB 60 million (assuming a 3,000-head farm). Expert B opined that the maximum per such farm was likely only RMB 35 million. Based on our estimated reported dairy farm construction costs, these estimates suggest that since going public, Huishan has overstated average dairy farm CapEx by one third (~RMB 29 million) to over one half (~RMB 54 million). Our estimates that actual construction costs are much lower than those calculated from PP&E expenditure analysis were corroborated by: a manager at one post-IPO farm, construction contractors at one farm presently being built, and bidding documents for two other post-IPO farms.

<div style="text-align: center;"><div style="text-align: center;">A common method to estimate farm construction costs is to estimate the budget per head. Our experts provided estimates of a reasonable construction budget for a 2,500-head milking farm in China built according to three quality standards: low, medium, and high. (The estimated budget is shown in Appendix 1). The estimated construction costs per head by standard are as follows:</div> </div>

这些估算结果对该公司有利，因为与“示范牧场”邓仕铺相比，这些成本确实较高。（所谓“示范牧场”，指的是邓仕铺和八家子牧场，其建设标准明显高于调查人员走访过的其他牧场。回山公司会在宣传材料和投资者参观活动中展示这些牧场。$^{32}$邓仕铺配备了集团内最先进、技术最顶尖的乳制品生产设备，且拥有良好的硬件设施，旨在给参观者留下深刻印象。很难认为那些设备较简陋、规模较小的牧场会具有相同的成本结构。根据环境影响报告以及截至2016年9月游客中心内的告示牌显示，邓仕铺的总投资额为9990万元人民币。其设计养殖容量为6,590头，这一数字相当于其他上市后建设的牧场的两倍。

<!--en-->
These estimates are company-favorable, as based on a comparison to “show farm” Dengshipu, these costs are high. (By “show farm”, we are referring to the Dengshipu and Bajiazi farms, which are built to a markedly higher standard than the other farms our investigators have visited. Huishan features these farms in promotional material and on investor tours. $ ^{32} $ Dengshipu features the best and “most technologically advanced” dairy equipment the Group has inside nice physical facilities to create a good impression for visitors. It is very hard to justify that other less sophisticated, smaller farms could have the same cost structure. Dengshipu’s total investment according to the environmental impact report and per a placard in the visitor center as of September 2016 is RMB 99.9 million. Its design capacity is 6,590 head, which is twice that of the other post-IPO farms.

根据我们的估算，并参考辽宁省的环境影响评估报告，辉山公司建设一座可饲养3,000头奶牛的牧场需花费9,000万至9,900万元人民币，相当于每头奶牛的建造成本为3万至3.3万元人民币；而建设一座可饲养4,000头奶牛的牧场需花费6,400万至8,100万元人民币，相当于每头奶牛的建造成本为1.6万至2.03万元人民币。

<!--en-->
With our estimate, supported by the Liaoning environmental impact reports, that Huishan is reporting spending RMB 90 million to RMB 99 million per 3,000-cow milking farm, the implied spending per head is RMB 30,000 to RMB 33,000, while a RMB 64-81 million expenditure for a 4,000 cow-breeding farm equates to a range of RMB 16,000-20,300/head.

我们的专家认为，调查人员走访的上市后建设的农场在建筑质量和建造水平上并不属于高端水平。某些功能和设备的取舍表明，这些农场充其量仍属于中端水平。专家A认为，高端……

<!--en-->
Our experts opined that the construction quality and build out of the post-IPO farms our investigators visited was not high end. The selection and omission of certain features and equipment suggested that the farms were still mid-range at best. Expert A opined that the upper

新建挤奶场的建设成本估算为每头奶牛20,000元人民币（一个拥有3,000头奶牛的农场需花费6,000万元人民币）。专家B表示：“从图片来看，我只能说这些农场的建设成本非常低廉。”他估计每个农场的最高开支为3,000万至3,500万元人民币，即每头奶牛约10,000至12,000元人民币。

<!--en-->
end estimates for the construction cost for new milking farms was RMB 20,000 per head, (RMB 60 million for a 3,000-cow farm). Expert B stated that “from the picture, all I can tell you is that these farms are built very cheaply,” and put his maximum expenditure at RMB 30-35 million per farm, or about RMB 10,000 to RMB 12,000 per head.

对于非泌乳牛场而言，其中最好的农场每头牛的估值上限为15,000元人民币，而下限则在10,000元人民币或以下。至于位于博裕寿山的惠山金星养殖场，专家A认为，由于该场缺乏自由栏舍和小棚舍，且作为育成牛或干奶牛场使用（未配备挤奶设备），在饲养密度较高时，其每头牛的估值可能仅为几千元人民币而已。

<!--en-->
The upper end estimate for non-milking cow farms was RMB 15,000 per head for the best among them, while the lower end is at or below 10,000 per head. In the case of Huishan Jinxing Farming in Boyu Shoushan, Expert A opined that with its lack of freestalls, small sheds, and use as a youngstock or dry heifer farm (without milking equipment) when at high stocking rates it could be as little as just in the single thousands of RMB per head.

我们的调查人员证实，该农场的建设成本估算值远低于我们所掌握的申报金额。在李家铺村与辽宁辉山乳业集团沃牛石养殖场的一名副场长交谈时我们得知，尽管该农场已作为“干奶牛”和“青年母牛”养殖场投入运营，但尚未完全运转。其挤奶设备的交付与安装已被推迟。由于2015年9月的卫星图像显示该农场建设已基本完工，我们对这一长时间的延误感到惊讶。

<!--en-->
Our investigators corroborated that construction cost estimates were much lower than our estimate of the reported amounts. In a discussion with a deputy farm manager on a newly built Liaoning Huishan Dairy Group Woniushi Farming Co. farm with a capacity for 3,000 cows, in Lijiapu Village we learned that although operational as a “dry cow” and “young heifer” farm, it was not yet fully operational. The delivery and installation of its milking equipment had been postponed. As satellite imagery from September 2015 showed that the farm construction was nearly complete, we found this long delay to be surprising.

在我们的调查中发现，这并非唯一一例挤奶农场虽已建到足以投入“运营”的程度，却在完成挤奶厅建设和/或安装所有必要的挤奶设备前就停滞下来的情况。这一发现意义重大，因为它意味着实际用于物业、厂房及设备的资本性支出与通过现金流分析得出的数值之间存在更大的差异。不过，为了保守起见，我们在计算中并未尝试将这一因素纳入模型。

<!--en-->
During our investigation, we found that this was not the sole instance of milking farms being built out far enough to become “operational,” but halted before completing the milking parlor and/or installing all of the necessary equipment for milking. This finding is significant because it implies an even greater delta between the real CapEx expenditure on PP&E, and that derived from the cash flow analysis. However, to be conservative in our estimates, we did not attempt to model this into our calculations.

发现该农场仍处于建设中期阶段，这一情况引发了关于建设成本的进一步讨论。农场经理列出了除土地外的建设成本明细。

<!--en-->
The finding that the farm was still in a mid-point stage of construction prompted further discussion about the build out costs. The farm manager broke down the construction costs, excluding land,

中国乳业专家顾问简介：专家A在中国从事乳业运营已有35年以上。他毕业于美国一所兽医学院。目前，他负责管理分布在十几个牧场中的超过2万头奶牛。在以往的工作中，他曾为一家大型外资乳业企业在华分部工作，负责监管约1.5万头奶牛并参与乳牛场建设。多年来，他走访过众多大型企业的乳牛场，对中国乳牛场的管理、运营及成本有着深刻的了解。

China Dairy Expert Advisor Bio's: Expert A has been engaged in dairy operations in China for over 35 years. He graduated from an American Veterinary College. In a prior position, he worked for a major foreign dairy operator in China, overseeing approximately 15,000 cows and oversaw dairy farm construction. Over the years, he has visited dairy farms of numerous large companies and has deep insight into Chinese dairy farm management, operations, and costs.

专家B是一位来自中国的顾问，专门从事乳制品行业咨询。他的公司为中国各地的奶牛场经营者提供支持，这些奶牛场共饲养着近35万头奶牛，其中包括为蒙牛和伊利等顶级品牌供货的大型牧场。他的专业领域涵盖农场运营与管理，以及新牧场的规划与开发。

<!--en-->
Expert B is a Chinese advisor with a specialty dairy consultancy. His company supports dairy farm operators across China that have nearly 350,000 cows under management, including large herds supplying the top bands such as Mengniu and Yili. His expertise includes farm operations and management, and new farm planning and development.

无论是否配备挤奶设备均可使用。据该农场经理称，截至目前的实际建设成本仅为2000万元人民币；而当所有与挤奶相关的设备（如挤奶厅、冷藏设施、检测设备等）安装完毕并使农场作为挤奶场投入运营后，总成本也仅约4000万元人民币。

<!--en-->
both with and without milking equipment. According to this farm's manager, the build out for the physical as constructed to date was just RMB 20 million and when all of the equipment related to milking, (such as the parlor, cold storage, testing, etc.) was installed and the farm was operational as a milking farm the total still came to only about RMB 40 million.

若再加上约576万元人民币的预付土地租赁费用，总成本将增至4576万元人民币，这一数字几乎与招股说明书中“募集资金用途”部分所暗示的平均成本一致。$ ^{33}$ 不过，这一数字仍不到向辽宁省环保局申报的项目总投资额9620万元人民币的一半，也约为我们估算的辉山乳业公布的平均开支的一半。$ ^{34}$

<!--en-->
If we add about RMB 5.76 million for a pre-paid land lease, the total increases to RMB 45.76 million, almost identical to the average cost implied in the IPO prospectus's Use of Proceeds. $ ^{33} $ However, this figure is still less than half of the RMB 96.2 million reported total investment for the project reported to the Liaoning Environmental Protection Bureau, and about half our estimate for Huishan's reported average spend. $ ^{34} $

位于沈阳郊区、尚处于建设初期的某农场建筑工人证实了我们对实际建设成本的估算。工人们确认，该场地将建成一座占地约200亩、可饲养3000头奶牛的辉山牧场。场内将包括办公室、宿舍、牛舍、生产设施等，从他们的描述来看，这些建筑将采用IPO后的“标准”设计，由混凝土和钢材建造而成。根据他们对该项目的了解，扣除土地和挤奶设备费用后，建设成本约为3000万元人民币。即便再增加2000万元人民币或更多用于购置其他乳制品生产相关设备，总成本仍仅为其在环境影响报告中公布的典型建设成本的一半左右。预计建设成本约为我们估算的辉山乳业公布的平均开支8900万元人民币的一半。

<!--en-->
Construction workers at a farm in the early stages of construction on the outskirts of Shenyang corroborate our estimates of actual construction costs. The workers confirmed that the site was to be a Huishan farm on about 200 mu designed to hold 3,000 cows. It would contain the office, dormitory, cow sheds, production facilities, etc. and from their description would be composed of concrete and steel buildings following the post-IPO “standard” design. Based on their project knowledge, the construction cost excluding land and the milking equipment would run about RMB 30 million. Even if adding another RMB 20 million or more for additional dairy production related equipment, the total is still close to just half of the typical build costs publicly announced in their environmental impact statements. The expected construction costs are about half of our estimate of Huishan’s reported average spend of RMB 89 million.

### 招标文件

<!--en-->
*Bidding Documents*

两份IPO后的辉山牧场招标文件支持了我们对实际农场建设成本的估算。辉山乳业不时发布招标公告，邀请承包商参与其新建项目。下面这份2014年的公告是针对辽宁世领自营牧场有限公司（辉山乳业的子公司）的一座3000头奶牛场项目。$ ^{35}$ 该项目占地约273,000平方米（410亩），建筑面积达61,000平方米，将成为辉山乳业规模最大的牧场之一。据报道，其建设成本估算仅为3000万元人民币。$ ^{36}$

<!--en-->
Bidding documents for two post-IPO Huishan farms support our estimates of actual farm construction costs. From time to time Huishan posts invitations for contractors to bid on their new construction projects. The posting from 2014 below is for a 3,000-head dairy farm for Liaoning Shiling Farming Co. Ltd., a subsidiary of Huishan. $ ^{35} $ It is to have a construction area of 61,000 m $ ^{2} $ on a farm of approximately 273,000 m $ ^{2} $ (410 mu) which would make it among Huishan's largest farms. The reported construction cost estimate is just RMB 30 million. $ ^{36} $

招标文件中提到了外墙、砖材、钢材及合金钢等建筑材料、防火墙、给排水系统、通风与空调系统、照明设施、围栏、牛床建设、沉淀池、厌氧反应器，以及冷藏设备、喂料设备和疾病预防检测设备。招标公告中还注明：“由于该项目所需的设备和材料种类繁多，并非所有要求都逐一列出，具体细节可能会有所变动。”

<!--en-->
The bidding documents include mention of the exterior walls, the brick, steel, and alloy steel, building materials, fire walls, plumbing and waste water drainage systems, ventilation, A/C, lighting, fences, cow bed construction, a sedimentation pond, anaerobic reactor, as well as cold storage, feeding equipment, disease prevention testing equipment. The bidding announcement also includes a note that, “Due to a wide range of equipment and materials required for the project, the requirements are not all listed one by one, and the specifics for the project may vary.”

同一时期的另一份招标文件涉及的是当时惠山子公司——惠山投资扶余沈阳养殖有限公司的一个4000头规模的种牛场项目$^{3738}$。该项目设计建筑面积达65,000平方米，预计建设成本为3500万元人民币。作为肉牛养殖场，其设计上本不应包含挤奶设备，这样能降低建设成本；但实际并未如此，这便成了一个有趣的异常现象。这一情况不仅进一步印证了实际农场建设成本远低于现金流分析所暗示的水平，而且该项目的重要性还在于：它是被转让给某家未具名关联方的四个项目之一，该关联方从事养牛业以及牛肉和犊牛肉的屠宰、营销与销售业务。

<!--en-->
Another bidding document from this period is for a 4,000-head breeding farm for the then Huishan subsidiary Huishan Investments Fuyu Shenyang Farming Co. Ltd. $ ^{3738} $ The construction area is designed to be 65,000 m $ ^{2} $ with an estimated construction cost of RMB 35 million. As a beef cattle farm, it should be designed without milking equipment, making it less expensive to construct. That it is not makes for an interesting anomaly. Besides adding to the evidence that the real farm construction costs were a fraction of that implied by cash flow analysis, this farm project is significant as it is among those four transferred to an undisclosed related party who is engaged in cattle ranching and the slaughtering, marketing, and sales of beef and veal.

虽然建成了四座此类农场，但随后它们便脱离了本集团的控制范围，因此很可能并未计入各报告期中所列明的公司运营的标准化农场总数中。不过，它们在一定程度上导致了资本支出的增加。即便如此，如下文所述，即便这四座农场的总投资额达到1.4亿人民币，也仅占新农场建设所导致的资本支出差额的一小部分而已。

<!--en-->
That four such farms were built, but subsequently transferred out of the Group's control they likely do not appear in the total number stating in each reporting period for the number of standardized farms that the Company is operating. However, they partially account for the CapEx inflation. Nevertheless, as seen below, even the four farms totaling RMB 140 million will make up only a small portion of the difference in the total CapEx inflation associated with new farm construction.

### 我们估计，辉山乳业在农场建设方面的资本支出被虚增了多达16亿人民币。

<!--en-->
*We estimate that in aggregate, Huishan inflated farm CapEx by as much as RMB 1.6 billion.*

在IPO之后启动或完工的32个已报告农场中，我们的实地调研表明，大多数农场采用了更新后的设计。其中规模较大的邓世铺农场便采用了更为先进的设计。我们认为其报告的9990万元人民币建设成本更有可能准确，因此将其排除在通胀计算之外。邓世铺农场的标牌上也注明其投资额为1亿元人民币。因此，我们仅针对采用新“标准”建造的31个农场来计算成本差异。下表汇总了各项估算值及其来源。

<!--en-->
Of the 32 reported farms started or completed since the IPO, our fieldwork suggests that most were built to an updated design. Among them is the larger scale Dengshipu Farm, which is built to a more sophisticated design. We believe its reported construction cost of RMB 99.9 million is more likely to be accurate, so we exclude it from the inflation calculation. A sign at Dengshipu also states that its investment was RMB 100 million. We thus calculate the cost differential for just 31 farms, which are built to the new “standard”. The table below summarizes the range of estimates and their sources.

若采用这些成本估算范围的上限（6000万元人民币），则这31个新“标准”农场的建设资本支出被高估了8.93亿元人民币。由于这只是农场成本估算的上限，因此8.93亿元人民币是我们对奶牛场资本支出通胀的最低估算值。

<!--en-->
Utilizing the upper end of these ranges of cost estimates (RMB 60 million), the construction CapEx for the 31 new “standard” farms was inflated by RMB 893 million. As this is the upper limit for the farm cost estimate, RMB 893 million is our low-end estimate for dairy farm CapEx inflation.

乳业专家B的估算更接近招标文件中提供的3000万~3500万元人民币这一数值。若以其高端估算值应用于全部31个农场，则资本支出通胀估计将达到16.68亿元人民币。而直接了解农场成本的辉山农场副经理所提供的估算可能更接近实际情况。按照辉山农场副经理报告的每座挤奶牛场4000万元人民币、同等土地租赁成本下的非挤奶牛场2000万元人民币来计算，预计总的资本支出通胀金额将超过16.68亿元人民币。

<!--en-->
Dairy Expert B's estimates were closer to those provided in the construction bidding documents of RMB 30-35 million. Using his high-end estimate and applying it to all 31 farms, the CapEx inflation is estimated to be RMB 1.668 billion. The estimates provided by the Huishan deputy farm manager with first-hand knowledge of the farms costs are probably closer to the truth. Applying the cost reported by the Huishan deputy farm manager of RMB 40 million per milking cow farm and RMB 20 million for a non-milking cow farm at the same land lease cost, the estimated total CapEx inflation rises to above RMB 1.668 billion.

正如我们在解释现金流分析相关假设时所指出的，当数据未明确披露时，我们在估算中采用了较为保守的假设；因此，奶牛场资本支出的实际总通胀幅度可能更大。

<!--en-->
As noted in explaining the assumptions regarding our cash flow analysis, we adopted conservative assumptions in our estimates when figures were not clearly disclosed, as such the real total inflation of dairy farm CapEx may be even greater.

“被挪用”的资本性支出最有可能被用作一种会计手段，即管理层需要利用虚增的销售数据（以及并不存在的现金）来匹配虚增的费用。

<!--en-->
The most likely use for the “diverted” CapEx was that of an accounting gimmick wherein Management needed to balance inflated sales (and therefore not existent cash) with inflated expenses.

### 新建但未完工的农场进一步引发了关于资本性支出的疑问

<!--en-->
*New but Incomplete Farms Raise Further Questions about CapEx Spend*

多例农场未完工的情况再次让我们对迄今为止投入的资本性支出总额产生质疑。这也表明该公司可能在市场低迷时期过度建设，和/或正面临阻碍项目完工的现金流问题。

<!--en-->
Several instances of incomplete farms again lead us to question the total amount of CapEx deployed to-date. It also suggests that the Company overbuilt in a depressed market and/or is facing cash flow problems hindering completion of these projects.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//90036fed-8fc5-499b-8535-45464d75d2cb/markdown_2/imgs/img_in_image_box_146_1144_1080_1440.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A18Z%2F-1%2F%2F5a2e7d4076a3a5fa85dc33b5f0eb5b42b831b8e04d67531bb1c315dd3ccf523f" alt="Image" width="76%" /></div>

辉山五峰乳业二道河子牧场施工未完成。照片由MWC调查员拍摄。

<!--en-->
Incomplete construction at Huishan Wufeng Dairy Erdao Hezi. Photo by MWC investigator.

根据调查员与辉山五峰乳业二道河子牧场工人的交谈，这座上市后的标准化挤奶牧场于2014年中期开始建设，并于2015年停工。与李家铺一样，二道河子牧场目前饲养的是不挤奶的奶牛。同样，在当天极寒天气下，柔软的侧墙被放低以减少穿堂风。据我们咨询的一位专家称，以这种方式试图保持热量，可能会导致湿度、氨气及病原体水平升高，从而产生破坏性影响。

<!--en-->
Per discussions our investigators had with workers at Huishan Wufeng Dairy Erdao Hezi, a post-IPO standard milking farm, construction there began in mid-2014 and halted in 2015. Like Lijiapu, Erdao Hezi is currently housing non-milking cows. Here too the soft side walls were lowered to reduce cross ventilation during the very cold weather that day. According to one of the experts that we consulted, in attempting to maintain heat in this fashion they run the risk of raising humidity, ammonia, and pathogen levels with damaging effects.

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//a435f87c-5ae3-419a-9b8f-5429f7fa8f21/markdown_0/imgs/img_in_image_box_300_364_923_596.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A08Z%2F-1%2F%2F9fab413f5629592a72f1b21e8577d1bac43a2e11c733a95ed6c07bf181f95942" alt="Image" width="50%" /></div>

<div style="text-align: center;"><div style="text-align: center;">Incomplete construction at Huishan Wufeng Dairy (Fuxin) Xintun Farm #2. Photo by MWC investigator.</div> </div>

辉山五峰乳业（阜新）新屯牧场#2同样被规划为可容纳3,000头奶牛的牧场。调查员于2016年11月走访了该牧场并与员工交谈。建设始于2014年中期，2015年3月开始有限运营。现场工作人员解释说，该牧场目前仅用于饲养犊牛，存栏量约为2,000头。由于设施尚未完工且设备未安装，牧场并未进行挤奶作业。他们预计该牧场将于2017年开始供奶。

<!--en-->
Huishan Wufeng Dairy (Fuxin) Xintun Farm #2 was also designed to be a 3,000-cow dairy farm. Our investigators visited the farm in November 2016 and spoke with employees. Construction started in the middle of 2014 and limited operations began in March 2015. Onsite staff explained that the farm is just engaged in raising calves and had about 2,000 head. The farm is not doing any milking because the facilities were incomplete and the equipment had not been installed. They expected the farm to begin supplying milk in 2017.

# 辉山董事长似乎通过一笔未披露的关联方交易窃取了价值至少1.5亿元人民币的资产

<!--en-->
*Huishan Chairman Appears to Have Stolen Assets Worth at Least RMB 150 Million Through an Undisclosed Related Party Transaction*

通过一笔未披露的关联方交易，我们估计辉山董事长杨凯窃取了至少1.5亿元人民币的资产。2014年12月（上市一年多后），辉山将一家拥有至少四个奶牛场的子公司转让给了几乎可以肯定是杨凯代理人的一方。我们根据对牧和佳员工的访谈及公开文件分析，估算这些牧场的价值为1.5亿元人民币。由于这些牧场很可能饲养有奶牛，其实际价值可能高于我们的估算。

<!--en-->
Through an undisclosed related party transaction, we estimate Huishan Chairman Yang Kai stole at least RMB 150 million of assets. In December 2014 (over one year post-IPO), Huishan transferred a subsidiary with at least four cattle farms to a party who is almost certainly a proxy for Chairman Yang. We estimate these farms were worth RMB 150 million, which we based on interviews of Muhejia employees and analysis of publicly available documents. The value of the farms was probably higher than our estimate because they likely contained cattle.

我们认为杨董事长意图利用股东资金来建造肉牛牧场，再将其转归己有。自2011年起，中国牛肉价格涨幅快于牛奶价格。2014年初，即便牛奶价格暴跌，牛肉价格仍持续上涨。$^{39}$ 由于产量无法满足需求，中国对牛肉的需求达到顶峰。$^{40}$ 对于拥有闲置犊牛和育成牛的大型乳业牧场主而言，这无疑是好消息和良机。今年秋季我们对杨凯旗下的养牛公司牧和佳的员工进行的访谈中得知，至少从2013年起，该公司便已制定进军屠宰及牛肉销售分销领域的计划。$^{41}$

<!--en-->
We believe Chairman Yang intended to use shareholder funds to pay for construction of beef ranches that he would transfer to himself. Starting in 2011, China’s beef prices rose faster than that of milk. In early 2014, beef prices remained on the ascent even as milk prices collapsed. $ ^{39} $ Demand for Chinese beef peaked as production fell short of demand. $ ^{40} $ For an owner of large-scale dairy farm with calves and heifers to spare, this was certainly great news and a good opportunity. We learned from interviews this fall with employees of Muhejia, a cattle ranching company owned by the Chairman Yang Kai, that since at least 2013 a plan had been in place for the company to move into the slaughtering and beef sales and distribution business. $ ^{41} $

小型牧场宰杀奶牛以出售牛肉

<!--en-->
Smaller farms slaughtered cows to sell beef

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//a435f87c-5ae3-419a-9b8f-5429f7fa8f21/markdown_1/imgs/img_in_chart_box_615_691_1081_982.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A16Z%2F-1%2F%2Fa9417e78f4728adf1f95f5aad820eb6ed2466c01a4493248c68214848c0b2b16" alt="Image" width="38%" /></div>

来自辉山2014财年汇丰银行演示文稿的图表，显示了牛肉价格的快速上涨以及小型牧场数量的减少。

<!--en-->
Charts from Huishan's FY14 HSBC Presentation showing rapid rise of beef prices and declining number of small farms.

杨董事长及其妻子拥有辽宁牧和佳畜牧科技有限公司（“牧和佳”）。$^{42}$ 如下文所述，牧和佳通过代理人从辉山手中夺取了至少四个农场。牧和佳在两年内曾五次更名，我们认为这是为掩盖此类（及其他）不当交易而采取的手段。下表显示了牧和佳异常频繁的更名情况：

彰武县穆和佳综合楼前的招牌，背景墙上的旧公司名称痕迹依稀可见。照片由MW调查员拍摄于2016年11月。

<!--en-->
Signboard at Muhejia complex in Zhangwu, ghosts of prior company names can be seen on wall in background. Photo by MW investigators, November 2016.

惠山在关于辽宁沐和佳的披露中，使用了非正式的英文名称“Liaoning Ainyveal”来指代它，我们认为这也是一种试图掩盖真相的做法。$ ^{43} $

<!--en-->
Huishan’s disclosures about Liaoning Muhejia refer to it by an informal English name, Liaoning Ainyveal, which we also believe is an attempt to obscure. $ ^{43} $

####  $ \underline{\text{F.U. with FuYu}} $

辉山将富裕农场转让给了由杨凯控制的牧合家。以下时间线列出了关键事件：

<!--en-->
Huishan transferred the Fuyu farms to Muhejia, an entity controlled by Yang Kai. The following timeline lays out the key events:

2014年4月11日：辉山成立辉山投资富裕沈阳养殖公司（“富裕”），以开展“奶牛养殖业”。$^{44}$（如下文所述，这似乎很有可能）

<!--en-->
April 11, 2014: Huishan establishes Huishan Investment Fuyu Shenyang Farming Company ("Fuyu") for "dairy farming business". $ ^{44} $ (As we explain below, it seems likely

这家子公司从一开始就是用于养牛业，而非乳制品养殖。

<!--en-->
this subsidiary was always intended to be used for beef ranching, rather than dairy farming.)

2014年5月至2014年12月：政府记录显示，在2014年5月至移交期间，富宇至少完成了四座养牛场的建设。

<!--en-->
May 2014 through December 2014: Government records show that between May 2014 and the transfer, Fuyu had completed construction of at least four cattle farms.

2014年12月23日：辉山乳业（中国）有限公司（前身为辉山投资有限公司）将其持有的富裕股份转让给新成立的辽宁福汉养殖有限公司，该公司由一名叫王兵的个人全资拥有并控制。辉山乳业2015财年的财务报告中并未披露此次出售子公司所获得的对价。$^{47}$ 王兵和福汉养殖公司几乎可以肯定是穆和佳及杨主席的代理人。我们估计所转让资产的价值至少为1.5亿元人民币。被转让的农场很可能包含牛群，这会进一步抬高转让价值。

<!--en-->
23 December 2014: Transfer of Fuyu shares from Huishan Dairy (China) Co., Ltd. (formerly named Huishan Investment Co., Ltd) to newly-formed entity Liaoning Fuhan Farming Company Ltd., controlled and 100%-owned by an individual named Wang Bing. Huishan's FY15 financial reports disclose no consideration received for the disposal of subsidiaries. $ ^{47} $ Wang and Fuhan Farming are almost certainly proxies for Muhejia and Chairman Yang. We estimate the value of the assets transferred was at least RMB 150 million. It is likely that the transferred farms included cattle, which would increase the value of transfer.

惠山于2014年4月11日成立了富宇。$ ^{48} $

<!--en-->
Huishan formed Fuyu on April 11, 2014. $ ^{48} $

## 38 报告期后的非调整事项

<!--en-->
*38 NON-ADJUSTING EVENTS AFTER THE REPORTING PERIOD*

a) 设立子公司

<!--en-->
a) Establishment of subsidiaries

2014年4月10日及2014年4月11日，本集团设立了五家全资子公司：辉山投资凤凰沈阳养殖有限公司、辉山投资恒丰沈阳养殖有限公司、辉山投资富宇沈阳养殖有限公司、辉山投资沙金沈阳养殖有限公司以及辉山投资腾达沈阳养殖有限公司，以开展奶牛养殖业务。截至本财务报表发布之日，上述子公司尚未开始运营。

<!--en-->
On April 10, 2014 and April 11, 2014, the Group established five wholly-owned subsidiaries, Huishan Investment Fenghuang Shenyang Farming Co., Ltd., Huishan Investment Hengfeng Shenyang Farming Co., Ltd., Huishan Investment Fuyu Shenyang Farming Co., Ltd., Huishan Investment Shajin Shenyang Farming Co., Ltd., and Huishan Investment Tengda Shenyang Farming Co., Ltd., to conduct dairy farming business. Up to the date of issue of these financial statements, the above subsidiaries have not started their operations yet.

$ \underline{\text{Government records show that Fuyu had completed construction of at least four beef ranches by the time of the transfer on December 23, 2014.}} $

辽宁省村农业与畜牧业经济委员会在2015年发布的一份报告中，列出了申请补贴的十四家辉山集团标准化养殖场。$^{49}$其中四家为抚余养殖场，其建设日期被标注为2014年5月至12月。公告中写道：

<!--en-->
A 2015 report by the Liaoning City Village Committee for Agricultural and Animal Husbandry Economy affairs lists fourteen Huishan Group standard farms that applied for subsidies. $ ^{49} $ Among them are four Fuyu farms with dates of construction listed as May through December 2014. The announcement reads:

《沈阳辉山乳业集团2015年合格标准化畜禽养殖场项目名单公示公告》

<!--en-->
“Notice of Public Announcement of the List of Qualified Standardized Livestock Farm Projects by the Huishan Dairy Group in Shenyang City in 2015

根据对辉山乳业集团标准化畜禽养殖场的材料审查、实地调查及项目验收情况，2015年辉山乳业集团14个标准化畜禽养殖场的合格项目名单已按区县（市）分类确定，现予以公示，接受社会监督。公示时间为7天（2015年12月24日至12月30日）。公示期间如发现问题，可通过电话或提交表格的方式向……反映。

<!--en-->
Based on material examination, field investigation, project inspection and acceptance of the Huishan Dairy Group's standardized livestock farms, the list of qualified projects of 14 standardized livestock farms of Huishan Dairy Group in 2015 were determined by districts and counties (cities) List, is to be made public for review by the community. It shall be publicly available for 7 days (December 24 to December 30, 2015). During the public period, if there is discovery of problems, you can phone or submit a form to the

市农牧业局将据此反映相关情况。所反映的问题须属实，且需使用提交人的真实姓名。信件的生效时间以寄出时的当地邮戳时间为准。

City Council of Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Department to reflect such findings. Problems reported are to be factual and the real name of the submitter must be used. The valid time of the letter shall be based on the local postmark time at the time of dispatch.

请注意，公告中称这些农场是为养牛业设计的，这强烈暗示这些农场从未打算由辉山公司运营，而整个计划一直是利用辉山投资者的资金为杨董事长建造肉牛牧场。此外，2014年8月更新的公开招标公告提供了关于富余某肉牛场建设项目的一些细节，该公告指出该农场是用于生产牛肉，而非乳制品或种畜。$ ^{50} $

<!--en-->
Note that the announcement states that these farms were designed for beef ranching, which strongly suggests that the farms were never intended to be operated by Huishan, and that the plan all along had been to use Huishan investors' money to build beef cattle ranches for Chairman Yang. Additionally, a public bidding announcement, updated in August 2014, provides some details on the construction project for one of Fuyu's cattle farms and states that the farm is designed for cattle meat (beef), not dairy or breeding. $ ^{50} $

王冰和富瀚牧业几乎可以肯定是沐禾佳及杨董事长的代理人。

<!--en-->
Wang and Fuhan Farming are almost certainly proxies for Muhejia and Chairman Yang.

工商局档案显示富余公司由沐禾佳控制。我们的实地调查证实沐禾佳确实控制着富余的农场。一篇宣传沐禾佳牛肉的博客也表明富余属于沐禾佳的农场。沈阳市政府发布的关于富余农场建设时间的公告中，富余与辉山使用的电话号码相同——尽管该公告是在转让一年后发布的，且将王冰列为富余的法定代表人。这表明尽管辉山已不拥有所有权，但富余仍受杨董事长的控制。

<!--en-->
SAIC files show that Fuyu is controlled by Muhejia. Our fieldwork confirmed that Muhejia controls the Fuyu farms. A blog promoting Muhejia beef shows that Fuyu is a Muhejia farm. The Shenyang government announcement showing Fuyu's farm construction timelines uses the same phone number for both Fuyu and Huishan – despite the announcement having been published one year after the transfer and reflecting Wang Bing as Fuyu's Legal Representative. This indicates Fuyu is still under Chairman Yang's control, despite Huishan having no ownership.

工商局档案显示富余公司由沐禾佳控制。工商局档案中列出的富余联系邮箱为yingcun.sha@muhejiagroup.com。电话号码88084909和88084919属于沐禾佳；其中一个号码也与华宝投资公司共用，该公司由杨凯所有并对沐禾佳进行投资，$ ^{51} $ 另一个号码则用于某些辉山农场。$ ^{52} $

<!--en-->
SAIC files show that Fuyu is controlled by Muhejia. SAIC files list the contact for Fuyu as yingcun.sha@muhejiagroup.com. The telephone numbers 88084909 and 88084919 are Muhejia phone numbers; one is also shared with Huabao Investments, a Yang Kai-owned company invested in Muhejia, $ ^{51} $ and the other used for some Huishan Farms. $ ^{52} $

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//e5ee684a-41ef-49d8-aff4-99f4d7420ff9/markdown_2/imgs/img_in_image_box_318_922_906_1202.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A11Z%2F-1%2F%2Fa654b4e515ffb8d00b52f1b5faa26f681014e6b8e934491a1a75feddb378eaae" alt="Image" width="48%" /></div>

我们的实地调查证实沐禾佳拥有富余农场。我们的调查员会见了认识王冰的一名沐禾佳销售员。该销售员确认自己参与了沐禾佳上游的养牛业务，并称杨凯仍是最高负责人。在走访

<!--en-->
Our fieldwork confirmed that Muhejia owns Fuyu farms. Our investigators met with a Muhejia salesman who knew Wang Bing. The salesman confirmed he is involved with Muhejia's upstream cattle ranch operations and that Yang Kai was still the big boss. When visiting the

富余农场时，我们发现农场大门上竟没有标识牌，这很不寻常。经询问得知，工人认为这些农场属于辉山，他们只是其中的一个分部，只不过该分部饲养的是肉牛而非产奶的奶牛。在一处富余农场，门卫反复确认该农场属于辉山且由辉山建造，但也承认该农场归沐禾佳所有。随后，这名门卫协助我们的研究人员致电农场经理，后者确认该农场确为富余农场。

<!--en-->
Fuyu farms, we found the farm gates to be uncharacteristically without signage. Upon inquiry, we learned that the workers believed that the farms belonged to Huishan with them being just another division, albeit one raising cattle for beef as opposed to dairy cows for milk. On one Fuyu farm, the gate guard repeatedly confirmed that the farm was Huishan's and built by Huishan, but also acknowledged that Muhejia owned the farm. This guard subsequently assisted our researchers to call the farm manager who then confirmed the farm was indeed Fuyu.

一篇宣传沐禾佳牛肉的博客显示沐禾佳拥有富余农场。该博客将富余肉牛场认定为沐禾佳集团的一部分。$ ^{53} $

<!--en-->
A blog promoting Muhejia beef shows that it owns Fuyu farms. The following blog identifies Fuyu Cattle Farm as part of the Muhejia group. $ ^{53} $

我们估计所转让资产的价值至少为人民币1.5亿元。

<!--en-->
We estimate the value of the assets transferred was at least RMB 150 million.

我们计算出从辉山转让给沐禾佳的四个农场的基础设施价值约为人民币1.5亿元。根据网上的建设成本估算，单个农场的预计项目成本为3500万元人民币（不含购买牛只的费用）。$ ^{54} $

<!--en-->
We calculate the value of the infrastructure of the four farms transferred from Huishan to Muhejia to be RMB 150 million. According to an online construction cost estimate, the estimated project cost for a single farm was RMB 35 million (excluding the cost of obtaining the cows). $ ^{54} $

由于有四个富余农场被转让，仅建设成本就相当于1.4亿元人民币的材料与时间价值。若计入额外的间接费用，并考虑到整体价值大于各部分之和，其隐含价值将超过人民币1.5亿元。

<!--en-->
As four Fuyu farms were transferred, the construction cost alone imputes a time and materials value of RMB 140 million. Including additional soft costs and considering the value of the whole exceeding that of the parts, the implied value would exceed RMB 150 million.

截至2014年底，富宇的总资产为1.504亿元人民币，负债为1.212亿元人民币，所有者权益则为2920万元人民币。惠山FY15年度报告中并未记载任何子公司处置情况。我们严重怀疑，此类未披露的违规交易会伴随贷款及其他负债的妥善重新安排。根据2014年工商年报，此次未披露的资产转让给惠山造成的损失可能至少相当于总资产价值，即1.504亿元人民币。

<!--en-->
At the end of 2014, Fuyu's total assets were reported as RMB 150.4 million, with RMB 121.2 million in liabilities, leaving owner's equity of capital as RMB 29.2 million. The Huishan FY15 AR does not record any disposal of subsidiaries. We highly doubt that an improper undisclosed transaction of this nature would be accompanied by a proper reassignment of loans and other liabilities. Based on the SAIC annual report from 2014, the likely loss to Huishan resulting from this undisclosed asset transfer is at least the total asset value, or RMB 150.4 million.

惠山很可能也转移了牛群，这使得盗窃规模进一步扩大。虽然福裕的业务范围直到2015年1月底才新增养殖业务，但在国家种畜禽许可证登记册中查询发现，福裕于2014年12月9日便获得了养殖许可。$ ^{55} $

<!--en-->
Huishan likely also transferred cattle, which would have made the theft even larger. While Fuyu's scope of operations was not updated to include breeding until late January 2015, a search of the National Breeder's license registry revealed that on December 9, 2014 Fuyu received its breeding permit. $ ^{55} $

<div style="text-align: center;"><img src="https://pplines-online.bj.bcebos.com/deploy/official/paddleocr/pp-ocr-vl-16-online//b1218d8b-462f-4053-9b13-6af10e570353/markdown_1/imgs/img_in_image_box_162_964_970_1201.jpg?authorization=bce-auth-v1%2FALTAKDN8mY5KlNI7zaRpLmOqrw%2F2026-10-12T06%3A45%3A08Z%2F-1%2F%2Fb71f8bff3ea225519f941c28e79166954c20db95d265d4908bdbbdccfe17a152" alt="Image" width="66%" /></div>

2015年，富宇申请了“规模化养牛企业补贴”，声称其中两个牧场的牛数量均超过1,200头，第三个牧场有510头。$^{56}$ 繁育记录显示，属于富宇的母牛从2015年1月7日开始受孕，这仅在转让后14天。到2015年1月29日公司正式更名并重新任命高层管理人员时，繁育记录中已列出151头年龄在14至31岁之间的母牛。

<!--en-->
In 2015, Fuyu applied for a “large scale cattle ranching enterprise subsidy”, declaring that two farms had more than 1,200 head per farm and a third had 510 head. $ ^{56} $ Breeding records show that cows belonging to Fuyu were impregnated beginning on January 7, 2015, just 14 days after the transfer. By the time of the official company name change and reappointment of senior management was completed on January 29, 2015, breeding records list 151 cows aged 14 to 31

这些牛怀孕的时间为数月，这表明它们早在12月下旬就已经在农场了，因此早于转移时间。$ ^{57} $

<!--en-->
months as being impregnated, suggesting these cows were already on the farm in late December, thus predating the transfer. $ ^{57} $

## 汇山的流动性似乎已岌岌可危，其资产状况存疑，且其所公布的2017年上半年现金流数据几乎可以肯定是虚假的。

<!--en-->
*Huishan's Liquidity Appears to be on the Knife's Edge, it has Dubious Assets, and its Reported 1H17 Cash Flow is Almost Certainly Fraudulent*

即便辉山的财务报表并非造假，由于杠杆率过高，该公司似乎已处于生死边缘。其杠杆水平之高，以至于在2016财年，辉山的审计师几乎就要出具“持续经营能力存疑”的审计意见。鉴于我们认定其公布的利润数据存在造假，我们毫不相信辉山能在不违约的情况下挺过明年。有大量迹象表明其正面临巨大的财务压力：包括辉山试图采用的融资方式、未完工的项目，以及即便按财务报表表面数字来看也极为糟糕的信贷指标。

<!--en-->
Even if Huishan’s financials were not fraudulent, the company appears to be on knife’s edge due to its excessive leverage. The leverage is so substantial that in FY16, Huishan’s auditor appears to have stopped just short of issuing a “going concern” qualification. Given that we conclude that its reported profits are fraudulent, we have no confidence that Huishan can make it through the next year without defaulting. There are numerous signs of enormous financial stress, including the types of financing Huishan is trying to employ, unfinished projects, and even taking Huishan’s financials at face value, horrendous credit metrics.

在我们看来，由于虚报利润和现金、估值过高的生物资产（被归类为第三级资产进行公允价值计量），以及某些高度可疑的资产科目，辉山资产负债表中的资产项目被严重高估。

<!--en-->
The asset side of Huishan's balance sheet, in our opinion, is massively overstated due to fraudulent profits and cash, overvalued biological assets (which are fair valued as Level 3 assets), and certain highly suspicious asset accounts.

$ \underline{\text{We believe Huishan is in very real danger of defaulting in the next year.}} $

辉山的审计师显然并未认定辉山的财务报表存在欺诈行为；然而，在2016财年审计中，该审计师似乎并未出具关于持续经营能力的保留意见。即便按辉山财务报表的表面数据来看，其信贷指标也已严重恶化至“红色区域”。我们认为，由于巨额短期债务的存在，辉山在未来一年内违约的可能性很高。辉山正在采取各种变通融资手段，这反映出其处境的窘迫。辉山未完成的项目也显示出其财务压力——2016年7月我们调查人员访问时，其耗资68亿元人民币的西丰液态奶工厂建设已经停工；而在辽宁康平开发区，我们并未看到那座预计投资88亿元人民币的液态奶工厂，只看到了一些奶牛雕像。

<!--en-->
Huishan’s auditor obviously has not concluded that Huishan’s that financials are fraudulent; yet, it appeared to stop just short of issuing a going concern qualification in its FY16 audit. Even taking Huishan’s financials at face value, its credit metrics are well into the “red zone”. In our opinion, Huishan has a high chance of defaulting in the next year due to its massive short-term debt. Huishan is resorting to creative financing that we believe shows its desperation. Huishan’s incomplete projects show it is financially stressed – construction on its RMB 6.8 billion Xifeng liquid milk plant had been stopped when our investigators visited in July 2016; and, instead of finding a RMB 8.8 billion liquid milk facility in the Kangping Development Zone in Liaoning, all we found were some cow statues.

惠山的审计师似乎在告诉投资者，该公司正处于生死攸关的关头。

<!--en-->
Huishan's auditor appears to telling investors the company is on knife's edge.

作为辉山的审计机构，毕马威在2016财年审计中似乎差点出具“持续经营”保留意见。（显然，审计机构在评估时并未考虑财务数据造假的可能性。）根据财务报表附注中的相关披露，我们的解读是：毕马威之所以没有正式出具持续经营保留意见，仅仅是因为得到了辉山董事们的保证。该保证声称公司拥有112亿元人民币的“无条件银行授信额度”。相关披露内容如下：

<!--en-->
KPMG, Huishan's auditor, appears to have been very close to issuing a “going concern” qualification in its FY16 audit. (The auditor obviously is not considering fraudulent financials in its assessment.) Our interpretation of the below disclosure in the notes to the financials is that KPMG only avoided issuing a formal going concern qualification based on assurances from Huishan's directors. The assurance centers around supposedly having “unconditional banking facilities” of RMB 11.2 billion. The disclosure reads as follows:

尽管截至2016年3月31日公司存在净流动负债，但这些合并财务报表仍是以持续经营为基础编制的。因为公司董事认为，根据截至这些合并财务报表发布之日集团尚未动用的112亿3162万2000元人民币无条件银行授信额度来看，集团拥有充足资金来偿还其在报告期结束后至少十二个月内到期的债务。

<!--en-->
“These consolidated financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis notwithstanding the net current liabilities as at March 31, 2016 because the directors of the Company are of the opinion that based on the unconditional banking facilities of RMB 11,231,622,000 not yet utilised by the Group as of the date of issue of these consolidated financial statements, the Group would have adequate funds to meet its liabilities as and when they fall due at least twelve months from the end of the reporting period.”

在此期间，公司董事认为以持续经营为基础编制合并财务报表是恰当的。$ ^{58} $

<!--en-->
period. Accordingly, the directors of the Company consider it is appropriate to prepare the consolidated financial statements on a going concern basis. $ ^{58} $

更令人担忧的是其2017年上半年中期报告：管理层称该信贷额度已缩减至仅50亿元人民币，这意味着如果这一流动资金池确实存在，也已被消耗了一半以上。$ ^{59} $

<!--en-->
Even more alarming is its 1H17 interim report, wherein Management reported this credit facility declined to just RMB 5.0 billion, implying that if this liquidity pool is real, it had been drained by more than half. $ ^{59} $

即便按辉山乳业公布的财务数据为准，其信贷指标也已严重进入“危险区”。

<!--en-->
Even taking Huishan's financials at face value, its credit metrics are well into the “red zone”.

其他令人咋舌的辉山乳业信贷指标（仍基于其公布的财务数据）包括：

<!--en-->
Other eye-popping Huishan credit metrics (taking its financials at face value) include:

- 利息支出从2014年的2.057亿人民币激增至2015年的3.228亿人民币，2016年更是达到6.81亿人民币。$ ^{606162} $ 截至2016年9月，2017财年上半年的财务费用已高达4.513亿人民币。$ ^{63} $

- 2016年，银行手续费及其他财务费用从2015年的1040万人民币增至3750万人民币，增幅达3倍。$ ^{64} $ 截至2016年9月30日的六个月内，这些费用竟高达5380万人民币。$ ^{65} $ 报告中并未注明这些“其他财务费用”具体指什么。

<!--en-->
- Net interest finance cost increased by almost 3x from RMB 205.7 million in 2014 to RMB 322.8 million in 2015 and RMB 681 million in 2016. $ ^{606162} $ As of September 2016, finance costs were up to RMB 451.3 million for the first half of the 2017 fiscal year. $ ^{63} $

- In 2016, bank charges and other finance costs increased 3x from RMB 10.4 million in 2015 to RMB 37.5 million in 2016. $ ^{64} $ For the six months ending September 30, 2016, these costs were a staggering RMB 53.8 million. $ ^{65} $ There is no footnote to explains what these “other finance costs” are.

用于担保应付票据的银行存款同比激增300%（2016年为9.46亿人民币，2015年为3.14亿人民币）。$ ^{66} $ 截至2016年9月30日，此类存款金额已达9.626亿人民币。$ ^{67} $ 辉山乳业并未说明这些应付票据的具体用途。

<!--en-->
Bank deposits to secure bills payable increased +300% year-on-year (RMB 946 million in 2016, up from RMB 314 million in 2015). $ ^{66} $ As of September 30, 2016, these deposits stood at RMB 962.6 million. $ ^{67} $ Huishan has shed no light on what these payables are.

- 另一项潜在的融资租赁协议涉及出售未指定的物业、厂房及设备，对价最高可达3亿人民币，回租利率为5%。⁶⁸

<!--en-->
- Another potential finance lease agreement for the sale of unspecified property, plants and equipment for a consideration up to RMB 300 million and a lease back rate of 5%.⁶⁸

由于巨额短期债务的存在，辉山乳业在未来一年内违约的可能性极高。

<!--en-->
Huishan has a high chance of defaulting in the next year due to its massive short-term debt.

该公司70%的债务将在一年内到期，且自由现金流有限，因此其债务状况预示着短期内极有可能发生违约。（此评估并未考虑我们关于该公司存在欺诈行为的结论。）辉山乳业必须设法解决一年内到期的111亿人民币债务问题。$ ^{69} $

<!--en-->
With 70% of the company's debt coming due in less than a year and a limited free cash flow profile, Huishan's debt profile presents a very high risk of a near term default. (This assessment is without considering our conclusion the company is a fraud.) Huishan will need to somehow address RMB 11.1 billion coming due within a year. $ ^{69} $

该公司近期试图通过出售奶牛并回租的方式来筹集资金，同时短期借款也显著增加，这引发了严重质疑。奶牛销售及回租行为以及贷款提取情况均表明辉山乳业对短期流动性及即将到期的债务深感忧虑。

<!--en-->
Serious questions arise with the company's recent cow sale lease back attempts significant recent increase in short-term borrowings. The cow sale and leaseback attempts and drawdowns on its

辉山乳业88%的债务已由物业、厂房及设备、租赁权和股权作为担保。此时该公司能否再提供额外抵押品值得怀疑——尤其是考虑到我们认定其物业、厂房及设备价值被严重高估。该公司还宣布正考虑在中国内地上市部分资产。$ ^{7071} $ 我们认为这进一步证明它已穷尽传统融资渠道，只能转向经验不足的投资者以避免公司倒闭。

<!--en-->
loan facilities imply that Huishan is concerned about its near-term liquidity and looming near-term debt maturity. 88% of Huishan's debt is already secured or guaranteed by PP&E, leases and equity. The ability for the company to offer up additional collateral at this stage is highly questionable – particularly given our conclusion that PP&E has been greatly inflated. The company has also announced that it is exploring listing some assets in mainland China. $ ^{7071} $ We see this as more evidence that it is running out of traditional ways to access capital, and is looking to less sophisticated investors to keep the company from collapsing.

该公司已设法从银行获得短期贷款以弥补短期资金缺口。辉山乳业首席财务官曾谈及延长贷款期限事宜；然而，2017年上半年一年内到期的债务却激增55.4%，达到111亿人民币。$ ^{72} $

<!--en-->
The company has found ways to get short-term loans from banks to shore up short-term cash needs. Huishan's CFO has been talking about extending the maturities on Huishan's loans; however, debt due within one year has spiked 55.4% in 1H17 to RMB 11.1 billion. $ ^{72} $

下图显示了过去三年间辉山乳业短期借款的巨大增幅。

<!--en-->
The graph below shows a huge increase in short-term debt borrowings for Huishan over the past three years.
